thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — PR #482 for SOC2 docs updated the audit-log examples. Needs security review and a tiny SDK snippet fix.
jon: Link? i'll pull it
maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 :arrow_right:
alex: skimmed — phrasing around 'retention period' feels off vs SOC2 controls. we currently say "30 days by default" but control requires "defined and documented retention policy"
elaine: @security-bot can you confirm recommended language? also, the python SDK example is using client.log_event(...) which we don't expose in public SDKs
security-bot: Automated check: PR touches /security/soc2/audit-logs.md; flagged 'informal retention phrasing'
kevin: For SDK snippet, we should show the instrumented header: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=...)
client.generate(..., audit_meta={"user_id": "1234", "request_id": "req-xyz"})
```
maria: +1 but we shouldn't encourage passing PII in audit_meta. maybe use pseudonymized user_id and mention encryption
jon: Proposed edit: "Audit logs capture request_id, model_variant, timestamp, and pseudonymized user identifier. Retention is governed by the customer's documented policy; default 30 days for hosted tier." ok?
alex: can we drop 'default 30 days' and instead say 'default retention is configurable; consult your plan' — legal liked that phrasing last quarter
elaine: Security approves language below. small nit: link to KMS guide missing. Also two dead links in the migration section.
security-bot: Security review: Approved with edits. See comments on PR for exact wording.
maria: I'll patch the python snippet to remove raw email example and add note about avoiding PII. Also will add Go snippet.
kevin: Go snippet draft:
```go
client.CreateAuditEvent(ctx, AuditEvent{
  RequestID: "req-xyz",
  ActorID: "anon-1234",
  Action: "model.generate",
})
```
maria: Thanks. Who wants to merge after I push changes? prefer someone from docs core
jon: I can merge after a quick CI run. ping me when ready :thumbsup:
maria: done — pushed changes, fixed two links, added KMS link, removed '30 days' wording. PR updated.
security-bot: CI: all checks passed.
jon: merging now
